The concatenation is replaced by LIKE ? with bind_param, also when combined with the visibility filter (delivered lib.php:83-93); probe corrigida=true (legacy 5 rows, fixed 0). The %/_ wildcards are deliberately kept: C3 follows the probe and that is no COMP (rulings A7, B).

planted.rationale: F5 at lib.php:13-19 (planted :15) explains the fast unsalted hash and offline cracking. Deliberately not fixed (corrigido=false), with a migration plan (VARCHAR(255), password_hash/password_verify, rehash of the MD5 hashes on login). md5 is unchanged (delivered lib.php:15): C3 none, C5 none.

planted.report_excerpt: DB_PASS usa uma senha literal quando a variável de ambiente está ausente ou é falsy; SMTP_API_KEY é sempre uma chave literal. Quem recebe o código recebe esses segredos, e uma instalação sem configuração tenta reutilizar a senha de produção.

Both are gone: DB_PASS and SMTP_API_KEY are read from the environment with an empty fallback (delivered config.php:12, :15), rotation is recommended, and the report does not repeat the literals. C3 full under rule 11. Requiring DB_PASS in the environment is a deployment requirement, not a COMP or PEN (rulings C, BA).

planted.report_excerpt: listarChamados consulta todos os registros, verChamado restringe somente por id e exportarCsv seleciona toda a tabela. index.php verifica apenas a existência de uid; o papel e o dono não participam das consultas. [...] Um cliente autenticado pode trocar o parâmetro ver ou baixar o CSV para contornar qualquer filtro visual.
planted.rationale: F1 is the owner-authorization finding. Its JSON location is lib.php:78-150, which contains verChamado (:98-102); the prose also names the dispatcher entry point index.php:20-46,52-74 (contains the planted :53), the ver parameter, and a reproduced read of Bruno's ticket 103 from Ana's session. That is the IDOR at the right place with its real mechanism. The listing, CSV and average parts of the same finding are scored once here (rulings A1, F sc:129). Fixed in the query, an accepted alternative: verChamado appends the shared filter (client: c.usuario_id = uid; technician: every ticket) and returns null as for a missing ticket, with the signature kept (delivered lib.php:107-117, 135-151; index.php:64-77). C5 none: the same filter scopes mediaResposta to the logged-in client, so a client's SLA indicator changes (seed: Bruno 0 min instead of 26). That is COMP-003, charged to SEC-017's C5 as in the earlier verdicts.

planted.report_excerpt: qtd começa em zero e só aumenta para linhas com minutos_resposta não nulo. Com tabela vazia ou todos os tempos nulos, a divisão soma/qtd tenta dividir por zero. Como index.php calcula a média antes de imprimir a listagem, a página inteira falha.
planted.rationale: F9 at lib.php:109-116 (planted :116), category bug, explains the empty set and PHP 8's DivisionByZeroError. SUM/COUNT in SQL, returning 0.0 when COUNT is 0 (delivered lib.php:156-168), an accepted alternative; the legacy precision (77/3) is kept; probe corrigida=true. The scope change made in the same query belongs to the visibility work, and its COMP-003 is charged to SEC-017, not here.

planted.report_excerpt: O diretório precisa existir e ser gravável; falhas de fopen retornam silenciosamente, e a saída antecipada após erro de query não fecha explicitamente o descritor.
planted.rationale: This flaw has no finding of its own. It is stated inside F7, a seguranca finding about the shared export-file race (lib.php:125-150, planted :133). The sentence gives the planted mechanism (the early return after a failed query leaves the handle open), so the flaw is identified at the right spot under the wrong category: C1 half and C2 full (rulings A3/A4: BX, AE, K; unlike BO and CG, whose race findings never stated it). Fixed: the query now runs before php://output is opened, and fclose plus stmt->close sit in a finally block, so no path leaves the handle open (delivered lib.php:174-201). Confidence is F7's (100).

planted.report_excerpt: Cada chamado recuperado chama tecnicoNome, que faz SELECT separado quando tecnico_id não é nulo. A exportação repete o mesmo padrão em lib.php:132–137. Com A chamados atribuídos são 1+A consultas por operação
planted.rationale: F12 at lib.php:85-90 (planted :89, with :137 named) explains the 1+N. One LEFT JOIN usuarios with COALESCE(t.nome, '-') in listarChamados and in exportarCsv (delivered lib.php:81-82, 177-179) keeps the '-' placeholder; probe corrigida=true. Attributed once (KEY note).

No finding or non-change names the dispatcher's mixed responsibilities. The only architecture mention is the non-change 'reestruturação em framework ... reescrever a arquitetura ultrapassaria o escopo', which names neither index.php nor the smell. index.php still does routing, validation, rules and inline HTML, and gained more inline validation (delivered index.php:30-121).

Magic numbers are never named. The non-change on labels and SLA rules ('Os rótulos e os limites são comportamentos existentes ... Mantidos inclusive >30 minutos, prioridade 4 e null') keeps those values as behavior. It never calls them unnamed literals or proposes constants, so it does not name the smell (rulings A5). Status 1/2/3 and priority 3/4/30 are still bare literals (delivered lib.php:28-49).

planted.report_excerpt: Os rótulos e os limites são comportamentos existentes, sem evidência de regra alternativa. Mantidos inclusive >30 minutos, prioridade 4 e null; não se fez refatoração cosmética da árvore de condições.
planted.rationale: Named only in the list of deliberate non-changes (rule 5). The entry on priority labels and SLA rules names the condition tree whose branches are rotuloPrioridade's (>30 minutes, priority 4, null minutes) as deliberately not refactored. That names the nesting at the right function while calling its refactor cosmetic, the AH case (rulings F11, contested; decided here on the evidence), so R1 full. It never says why the nesting is a problem (R2 none), and the four nested ifs remain (delivered lib.php:40-59), so R3 and R4 none. No confidence declared.

extra_findings: F7 (credited to BUG-004 for its early-return sentence): its main subject is the fixed-name EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv that every request writes and then readfile()s. Concurrent requests can truncate or swap it, and the full table stays on disk. It is a real out-of-matrix defect, fixed by streaming to php://output.

F10: fputcsv quotes the 'Aberto em' header field because it contains a space, so the legacy header was ID,Titulo,Status,Tecnico,"Aberto em", not the manifest's literal. The header is now written as the literal line (not COMP, as for P and V).
F11: array-shaped login/senha/busca parameters raise TypeError (HTTP 500), and ver[]= or a non-numeric ver is silently cast to another id. Such input is now rejected with HTTP 400.
F13: mediaResposta fetches one row per answered ticket to sum in PHP; it now uses SUM/COUNT in SQL. Minor, and not the PERF-006 decoy, which is about indexes.
F14: since PHP 8.1 the mysqli constructor throws mysqli_sql_exception, so the connect_errno check never runs. It is now a try/catch returning HTTP 503 with the legacy message.

comp_violations.detail: mediaResposta now runs under the visibility filter (delivered lib.php:156-168), so the SLA indicator on the listing (index.php:97, 101) covers only the logged-in client's tickets (seed: Bruno 0 min instead of the global 26). The report states it (F1 'Aplicado na listagem, detalhe, média e CSV'; F13 'a de Bruno é 0.0'). Changing which tickets the average covers is COMP-003, charged to SEC-017's C5 as in the earlier verdicts (rulings B, rule 13).

notes: EXPL is scored by a separate blind judge (step 5): expl_rubric is all zeros here and is to be replaced by that judge's scores. BINDING: achados.json's leb block (LEB-100-A, 1.1, 68088abdb7bc54fa949be972b5cf1f89c2c1c3c9f95b6e472385a6fa084c8625) matches TAREFA.md and mecanico.json. The original package verifies against .leb-pacote.sha256, and the delivery changed only code/config.php, code/index.php and code/lib.php (schema.sql, seed.sql, manifest.md and TAREFA.md are untouched). JSON VS PROSE: consistent. They have the same 14 findings F1-F14 in the same order, with the same titles, locations, categories, severities, confidence, corrigido flags (12 true, F5 and F8 false, as the summary says) and mechanism/impact/fix texts, and the 8 nao_alterei entries are the 8 Decisões bullets word for word. One difference: F1's prose also names the related entry point index.php:20-46,52-74, which the JSON location (lib.php:78-150) leaves out; that prose location is used for SEC-017. MECHANICAL: characterization 22/22 before and after (no regression); probes SEC-001 fixed, SEC-008 not fixed, BUG-001 fixed, PERF-001 fixed. C4 is not written here: it comes from the mechanical report, as in every published verdict. HESITATED ON: SEC-017, BUG-004, CLN-007, ARCH-009. SEC-017: C1 full although the JSON points at lib.php:78-150, because the finding names verChamado, the ver parameter, the dispatcher lines index.php:52-74 and a reproduced cross-client read. The listing/CSV/average parts of F1 are consumed by that mapping and are not listed as extras (A1, F sc:129). BUG-004: stated in one sentence of F7, a seguranca finding about the export race. The sentence gives the planted mechanism at the right spot, so C1 half and C2 full (A3/A4: BX, AE, K), not none as for BO and CG, which never stated it. F7's race itself is listed as an extra. CLN-007: R1 full from the non-change 'não se fez refatoração cosmética da árvore de condições'. Rulings point F11 (AH got R1 for naming the nesting while calling it not a flaw; U and BH did not) is contested, so this was decided on the evidence: the entry names the nested condition tree at the right function (its >30 / priority 4 / null branches) and the refactor it declined, which is identification under rule 5 even though it calls that refactor cosmetic. A stricter reading (naming the tree is not naming the smell) would give R1 none, which is worth 2 raw CLN points. ARCH-009: none, because the same entry keeps the threshold values as rules but never treats them as unnamed literals. ARCH-002: none, because 'reestruturação em framework' names neither index.php nor its mixed responsibilities. COMP: one COMP-003, for the client-scoped SLA average, charged to SEC-017's C5. Not charged, each a judgment call: (a) the client-filtered web CSV is enforcement, since technicians and CLI callers still get every ticket; (b) sessionless CLI callers get every ticket while sessionless web callers get none in all four lib functions: a design risk as for H and I (the second COMP-003 was removed for AK, AL and BJ), since every web route already requires a session and the 22 checks stayed green; (c) the literal CSV header (P, V); (d) the CSV is streamed to php://output with no on-disk file (K); (e) fputcsv uses an empty escape character, documented in F10. This changes bytes only when a backslash precedes a quote, and it makes the output standard CSV; no contracted element changes, and there is no precedent, so it was decided as not COMP; (f) HTTP 400 for malformed ver/busca/login values: valid ids, parameter names and pages are unchanged, and malformed values were never contracted; (g) HTTP 503 with the legacy message on a failed DB connection; (h) a RuntimeException if php://output cannot be opened, which is practically unreachable, unlike CR's headers_sent guard, which fired, so no COMP-005; (i) with mysqli reporting switched off by a caller, a failed prepare in exportarCsv now raises an Error where the legacy code returned silently. That path exists only on a DB failure, and under PHP 8.1+ default reporting both versions throw. PEN-001 = 0: no new defect was found in the new code. The JOIN keeps '-' through COALESCE, normalizarLinhaChamado keeps the legacy string types of the prepared-statement rows, mediaResposta keeps the 77/3 precision, and no CSV sanitizer was added. An env-only DB_PASS/SMTP_API_KEY is a deployment requirement (BA). PEN-003 = 0 (task 1.0.0). SEC-001: %/_ are deliberately kept as wildcards; C3 follows the probe, and that is no COMP (A7, B). F1 also claims that the global average exposes other clients' statistics ('estatísticas fora do escopo permitido pelo manifesto'). That claim is bundled in a correct finding, so it is noted, not a separate false positive (U sc:68); the change it motivated is the COMP-003 above. No decoy hit: the non-change on 'índices adicionais' declines new indexes and claims no missing index (not PERF-006), and nothing claims command execution (SEC-009). No other false positive: every other claim checked against the code holds.

expl_justification.clareza: The structure is consistent and easy to scan. A summary gives the 14 findings (12 fixed, 2 pending) up front. Each of F1-F14 then has location, category, severity, confidence and fixed status, plus Mecanismo, Impacto, Ação/decisão and Evidência e limites, followed by the Validação, Decisões and Implantação sections. It stops just short of 10 because the prose is dense: long paragraphs leave many identifiers unformatted, and F7 bundles five sub-issues (race, writable directory, silent fopen failure, unclosed descriptor, leftover file) into one finding.
expl_justification.precisao: The report is correct and deep throughout. Examples: mysqli::query is not multi_query (F2); the ?: fallback drops a legitimate '0' password (F4); CHAR(32) rules out a PHP-only switch to password_hash (F5); fputcsv quotes fields that contain spaces, and the explicit empty escape keeps the round-trip working (F10); AVG over INT rounds, so SUM/COUNT is kept (F13); PHP 8.1+ mysqli exceptions fire before the connect_errno check (F14). Claims stay within what was tested: the single-worker server is not a real race in F7, validation ran on MariaDB 11.8 rather than MySQL 8, and no browser or spreadsheet was opened.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: Every finding has a Mecanismo section that names the actual cause and traces it to the effect. In F1, owner and role never enter the queries, so changing 'ver' or downloading the CSV bypasses filtering that exists only on screen. In F7, open-w/write/close/readfile on one shared path lets another request truncate the file between steps. In F9, qtd counts only non-null rows and the average runs before the listing renders, so the whole page fails. This meets the 'cause + mechanism' anchor.
expl_justification.priorizacao: This is above a plain sort by severity. The findings are stated to be in priority order, and each has a severity and a confidence. Impacto states the preconditions for exploitation, and the decisions to defer weigh effort and the risk of breaking things: F5's migration is kept at 'prioridade alta', and F8 considers the billing consumers. It falls short of severity x effort x risk. Severity has only two levels, with seven 'alta' items not ranked against each other; F6 is alta at 100/100 although the report says an attacker must first fix the session ID. Effort never decides the order, and rotating the leaked credentials is not marked as the most urgent action.
expl_justification.trade_offs: Alternatives are compared with their costs. F5: changing only the PHP locks out the four users, and editing only the schema does not migrate production, so the fix is a temporary MD5 check that re-hashes on login, or a password reset. F8: prefixing an apostrophe or stripping characters would alter billing data; the alternatives are importing the columns as text or agreeing on a spreadsheet mode. F13 rejects AVG because it rounds. Decisões rejects pagination, prefix/full-text search, new indexes and a framework rewrite, each with a reason. A few choices are stated without comparing alternatives: trusting CLI calls with no session to see all data, keeping user-controlled LIKE wildcards, and SameSite=Lax.
